tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bzhi'i nang tshan lam zab phyi nang sbrags ma'i nyams len thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so// ༈ /he ru ka dpal dgyes mdzad bdag med yum// ḍā ki'i zhal 'ong brtse chen snying po la// bir+was rjes gdams zab don bla ma'i lam// nang ma'i nyams len ngag 'don nyung ngur bri// 'dir lam zab nang ma'i nyams len ni/ slob bshad pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su lam dus dang sbrel nas mdzad pa'i rdor sems song mtshams 'di ga rang gi sems bskyed nas 'go rtsam pa yin pas 'di ltar ro// bdag gis nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal he ru ka dang bla ma tha mi dad pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma shrī he ru ka bh+yaḥ phyi mchod ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na lha dang mi la sogs pa bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa dang bar ma'i sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud par bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag gti mug dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdon thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis sogs lan gsum/ bdag gi lha dang gnyen grogs 'khor 'bang thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud sogs/ bdag 'dod chags dang bral bar sogs lan gsum/ bdag gi longs spyod kyi dngos po thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud sogs/ bdag ser sna dang bral bar sogs lan gsum/ nang mchod ni/ mdun du thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du lag pa g.yas pa'i ral gris rang gi thod pa bcad de sgyed bu'i steng du dpral ba rang la bstan nas bkal ba'i nang du ral gris rkang pa g.yas g.yon lag pa g.yon pa/

mgo bo'i lhag ma ro smad ro stod sogs lus kyi cha shas rnams bcad nas bskyur ba'i steng du lag pa g.yas ral gri dang bcas pa'ang 'phang*/ rang rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i bdag nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang mchod ni/ rang gi snying ga nas rig ma yid du 'ong ba zhig spros te/ yum la thim pas he ru ka yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod yul mchod mkhan mchod tshul thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa spros bral du gyur/ de nas/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs brjod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dang dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun nam gsum sogs skabs ltar sbyar/ bla ma he ru ka de nyid 'od du zhu/ rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa zhes pa nas/ snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ lus rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de ltar phyi rang lus dpal kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag nyid khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po bco brgyad ngag dbang mkhyen rab legs bshad rgya mtsho bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang*/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas kyi tha mi dad pa phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/

de'i dbu'i gtsug tu ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*/ ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po tha mi dad pa phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo sogs dang*/ de'i dbu'i gtsug tu rin chen mkhyen brtse dbang po dang*/ blo gros snying po tha mi dad pa phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum zhes sogs brgyud pa kun la/ mgor de'i dbu'i gtsug tu dang*/ mjug tu phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa zhes btags pa re re bzhin sbyar nas/ byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags dang*/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan tha mi dad pa/ dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor dang*/ byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tha mi dad pa/ khri chen mkhyen brtse dbang po dang*/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin tha mi dad pa/ ngag dbang blo gsal phun tshogs dang*/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med tha mi dad pa/ yab rje kun dga' blo gros/ khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ khri chen bsod nams dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ rje btsun kun spangs pa chen po/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ nyan chen bsod nams bstan pa/ tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal ba/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ 'jam mgon brtse chen snying po/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ rje btsun bdag med ma/ de'i dbu'i gtsug tu sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de thams cad kyang bde stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/

zhes mas rim gyis gsal btab cing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ bla ma so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros skyabs yul thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la thim par gyur par bsam/ de nas/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyi rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma la thim/ de nyid phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la thim/ de bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan gong bzhin la yas rim gyi re re bzhin du mgor de nyid phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis zhes dang*/ mjug tu la thim zhes pa sbyar nas/ de nyid phyi kye rdo rje sogs nas/ rin chen mkhyen brtse dbang po dang*/ brag ra chos kyi nyi ma tha mi dad pa la thim/ de nyid phyi kyai rdo rje sogs nas/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*/ ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po tha mi dad pa la thim/ de nyid phyi kyai rdo rje sogs nas/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po bco brgyad ngag dbang mkhyen rab legs bshad rgya mtsho bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang*/ dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' theg chen dpal 'bar phrin las bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i zhal snga nas kyi tha mi dad pa phyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa la thim pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi dbang bzhi'i chu bo gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/

par bsam la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la dbang dang dngos grub zab mo stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum snyoms par gzhug pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi spyi bo nas bab pa bde chen 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang*/ bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang dbang*/ smin mtshams yan chad byang sems kyi gang ba sher dbang*/ spyi bo'i gnas su bde drod 'bar bas yul snang stong gi ting nge 'dzin/ rtsal mos gus su shar ba/ dga' ba'i ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum dbang thob/ lus rtsa gnas gyur/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob par gyur/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang sems longs spyod 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang*/ bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang dbang*/ mgrin pa yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher dbang*/ mgrin par bde drod 'bar bas shes pa gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin/ gdangs 'gags med du shar ba/ mchog dga'i ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi yi ge gnas gyur/ 'bras bu longs sku thob par gyur/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang sems chos kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang*/ bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang dbang*/ snying ga yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher dbang*/ snying gar bde drod 'bar bas lus bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid bdud rtsi gnas gyur/ 'bras bu chos sku thob par gyur/ bla ma yab yum bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang*/

bde skyong gi 'khor lo/ dbang po dang yan lag gi lha rnams la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang*/ bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang dbang*/ lte ba yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher dbang*/ lte gsang gnyis su bde drod 'bar bas bde stong mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba/ lhan skyes kyi ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa rlung gnas gyur/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par gyur par bsam/ lta ba spros bral gyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag mthar/ skye ba kun tu sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo// 'di 'bad dge tshogs dri med gaṅgā'i klung*// 'gro kun phan bde'i rgya mtshor yongs 'khyil bas// don gnyis bcud du smin pa'i yid bzhin nor// lhag bsam gdeng can gtsug na rgyal gyur cig /ces lam zab phyi nang sbrags te nyams su len pa'i ngag 'don/ dam pa'i gsung bzhin myur du bris pa 'di ni rdo rje'i slob bu mang thos 'phrin las yon tan gyis bskul ma mdzad ngor/ lce btsun dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor gyis chu lug gro bzhin zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi zla shel dbang po nya yongs su gang ba'i nyin dpal rgyun gyi dbang po'i bla brang lcang lo can du bkod pa'i yi ge pa'ang bskul ba po nyid kyis gus pas bgyis pa 'dis kyang snyan rgyud zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs brgyar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
